adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on failed validation in `handleAdd` but is not cleared when the user edits the emails (`MultiEmail` onChange only updates `multiEmailValue`), nor in the mutation `onSuccess` (it closes/reset values but doesn’t call `setIsInvalidEmail(false)`), nor when the dialog is dismissed via `onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}` (e.g., clicking outside). Since the dialog component stays mounted in `BookingListItem`, reopening can show stale error UI. Also, `handleAdd` returns early when `multiEmailValue.length === 0` (possible if the user removes the last field), producing no feedback and leaving any prior `isInvalidEmail` state untouched.
